name: api
intro: Every procedure of the OpenCRQ API: 428 (292 queries, 135 mutations, 1 subscription) in 52 namespaces. The API is [tRPC](https://trpc.io) over HTTP under `/trpc/<procedure>`: a query is a `GET` with its input as JSON in the `input` parameter, a mutation a `POST` with its input as the JSON body. Authenticate with the session cookie of a signed-in user, or a service account's token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; a procedure that reads or writes a tenant's data needs the tenant in the `x-tenant-id` header. An input field marked `?` is optional.
